pictures.author: Nina Tomašević
pictures.observations: Full winter front view shows pale stone plinth/stepped arched door surround, red-brown brick rectangular base, projecting columned front loggia/cornices, two smaller round corner turrets with low domed dark caps/finials, taller round central shaft/arched glazing/pale head rim and steep dark roof. Snow, visitors, wires and separate fortress ruins are omitted.

pictures.author: Ivan Aleksic
pictures.observations: Unsnowed opposite close view resolves the curved columned gallery/open spaces, round brick shaft, shallow projecting arched window sills, pale decorative head/cornice and steep dark conical roof. The existing shared bricks/stone/paint/glass provide the material approximation; no photo pixels or heraldry copied.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Gardoš Tower connected exterior: native asymmetric rounded/rectangular brick base and pale plinth, stepped arched closed entry, projecting front loggia and curved open columned gallery, two smaller round turrets/capped roofs/finials, central round brick shaft with arched recessed closed glazing/projecting sills/vertical piers, pale head/cornice and closed steep dark roof/finial. Four existing shared brick/raw-stone/paint/window-grid graphs. No snow, visitors, signs/heraldry/photo atlas, furnished interior, separate fortress ruins or whole hill/platform.
